title: Codka Cadawnimada
intro: Kahor intaanan bini'aadamkii ugu horreeyay dhulka ku socon, qof awood weyn leh ayaa taagnaa meel nabad buuxda leh, oo ay ku hareeraysan yihiin nafaha ugu daacadsan. Markii hal amar la bixiyay, cod kastaa wuu is dhiibay - laakiin hal cod ayaa ka soo baxayay diidmo, diidmaduna waxay ku dhawaaqi jirtay da' kasta ilaa Maalinta ugu dambeysa. Waa kuma kan dhacay?
clues: Waxaa la iga abuuray wax si fiican u gubanaya, halka kuwa kale ee agteyda ahna laga sameeyay waxay ku socdeen.
Waxaan ku noolaa meel quduus ah oo dhex taal makhluuqaadka quduuska ah, ilaa amar keli ah uu wax walba rogay.
Markii amarku yimid, naf kasta oo dhan ayaa u sujuudday aniga mooyaane; diidmadaydu waxay ka dhalatay kibir.
Waxaa la iga saaray meeshaas quduuska ah, iyadoo lagu calaamadeeyay habaar waara oo weligeed jiraya.
Waxaan baryay waqti ilaa Maalinta Qiyaamaha, waana la ii ogolaaday. Waxaan ku dhaartay inaan u dhawaado naf kasta oo aan marin habaabiyo.
Marka buunku dhawaaqo, kuwii i raacay waxay la wadaagi doonaan qaddarkayga, iyagoo igula biiraya dab ololaya oo aan cid caawisa ka badbaadin karin.

outcome.answer: Iska tuur, nasasho ilaa Maalin ballan ah

arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
verse: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few." (17:62)
